name: EMATool
description: Exponential Moving Average - weighted moving average giving more importance to recent prices. Used to identify trend direction and support/resistance levels.

fields.label: Candle Data
fields.description: The dataRef string returned from a market data tool (YahooFinanceTool, PolygonTool, etc). You MUST first call a market data tool, wait for its response containing dataRef, then use that exact dataRef value here. Do NOT guess or invent this value.

fields.label: Symbol
fields.description: The ticker symbol for the asset being analyzed (e.g. AAPL, BTCUSDT). Use the same symbol that was passed to the market data tool.

fields.label: Timeframe
fields.description: The timeframe/interval of the candle data (e.g. 1m, 5m, 1h, 1d). Must match the timeframe used when fetching the market data.

fields.label: EMA Period
fields.description: Number of periods for EMA calculation. CHOOSE based on trend analysis goal: 9-12 for short-term momentum and quick trend changes, 20-26 for medium-term trend direction (commonly used), 50 for intermediate trend, 100-200 for long-term trend and major support/resistance. For volatile stocks, use longer periods.
